metadata.description: LazyTrae Session tracking — mirrors LazyCodex session-state-lock.ts behavior. Tracks active sessions, compaction state, and session-level state for cross-session continuation.
metadata.lock_mechanism: File-based mutation lock (mkdir-based, 20 retries, 5ms delay). Mirrors LazyCodex withSessionStateLock pattern from lazycodex/plugins/omo/components/rules/src/session-state-lock.ts.
